module: Vehicle extension that starts a small local HTTP/JSON server (utils/httpJsonServer) on localhost:23512 when the extension loads. It answers two routes: v1/ping and v1/getData (nodes, beams and triangles of the vehicle, for an external editor). The extension is loaded per vehicle; the server is started only once in this VM.
usage:
-- external request: POST/GET http://localhost:23512/v1/ping  ->  {"ok": true}
-- http://localhost:23512/v1/getData -> [nodes, beams, tris]
notes: v1/getData format: array {nodes, beams, tris}. nodes[k] = {cid, {x, y, z}, nodeWeight} (nodes without wheelTreadBeamDeform); beams[k] = {cid, {id1, id2}, beamSpring, beamDamp} (beams without wheelID); tris[k] = {{id1, id2, id3}} (triangles having a cid).
The port (23512) and host (localhost) are hardcoded; a request without uri returns nil (HTTP 500 error).
The server is processed in updateGFX (httpJsonServer.update): it only answers once per frame, and only as long as the extension is loaded.
onExtensionLoaded writes an error-level log ('INIT WEBSERVER TO PORT ...') even in normal operation.
jsonRequest (HTTP POST client with body data=<json>) is defined but never called or exported.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called when the extension loads: starts the JSON HTTP server once on localhost:23512 with the internal request handler.

onVehicleLoaded.desc: Hook called when the vehicle is loaded; empty body (debug code commented out).

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame: processes the HTTP server's pending connections.
